_comment: Squad database. generate.js renders the SAME seven columns on every match page from this file. fixtures.json holds only who starts; this holds who they are. Missing fields render as an em dash and generate.js warns.

players.name: Emiliano Martínez
players.atChelsea: August 2026, £7.5m from Aston Villa — signed the morning of the Brighton match
players.previously: Aston Villa; Arsenal; loans at Oxford United, Sheffield Wednesday, Wolves, Getafe and Reading
players.style: World Cup winner and a renowned penalty specialist — commanding, vocal, and a serial big-moment goalkeeper. Arrived at 31 as a deliberate experience signing and went straight into the XI, which pushed Robert Sánchez out of the squad entirely.

players.name: Robert Sánchez
players.previously: Brighton; Rochdale & Forest Green (loans); Levante academy
players.style: At 6 ft 5 in he fills the goal and is a genuinely good shot-stopper on his day, but he is the squad's most argued-over starter after repeated errors in distribution and decision-making.

players.name: Mike Penders
players.atChelsea: Signed 2025; first-team squad from 2026 after a Strasbourg loan
players.style: Tall, quick off his line and comfortable with the ball at his feet. Made his competitive Chelsea debut in the Carabao Cup this month.

players.name: Reece James
players.atChelsea: Academy from 2005; senior squad since 2019 — 8th first-team season
players.style: Club captain. The best crosser and long-range striker of a ball at the club. In a back three he covers the right channel and steps out to start attacks. Alonso has also used him in a midfield two. Availability, never ability, is the question.

players.name: Wesley Fofana
players.atChelsea: Since Aug 2022, about £70m from Leicester City
players.style: Quick, aggressive and front-footed, strong in single combat and comfortable defending a high line. Two long injury absences have cost him most of three seasons, so every run of games is treated as fragile.

players.name: Maxence Lacroix
players.style: Reportedly the fastest centre-back in the Premier League by top speed. Defends aggressively on the front foot, dominant in the air at 6 ft 3 in, comfortable as the middle man of a three. The first player over 26 Chelsea have paid a fee for since 2022.
players.stat: 35 apps (all starts), 11 clean sheets|2025–26, Crystal Palace

players.name: Levi Colwill
players.atChelsea: Academy from 2012; first team since 2023 — 4th senior season
players.style: Left-footed, unflustered, progresses the ball through the left channel rather than sideways around it. Lost almost all of last season to an ACL injury; Alonso is managing his minutes deliberately.

players.name: Josh Acheampong
players.style: Composed young centre-back who reads danger early and is comfortable stepping into midfield with the ball. Started the season opener.

players.name: Malo Gusto
players.style: Energetic, tenacious right-sided defender who overlaps hard and defends the touchline aggressively. Alonso has also asked him to tuck into midfield.

players.name: Jorrel Hato
players.style: Left-footed, positionally mature well beyond his age, and more defender than flying full-back. Safer and less adventurous than Cucurella was on that side.

players.name: Pep Chavarría
players.style: Attacking left wing-back with a reliable delivery and real stamina up and down the flank. Signed as the specialist replacement for Cucurella.

players.name: Marco Palestra
players.atChelsea: July 2026, roughly £43–50m from Atalanta — contract to 2033
players.style: A lung-busting, up-and-down right wing-back with enormous repeat-sprint volume. Signed to do the job Jeremie Frimpong did for Alonso at Leverkusen. Injured in pre-season and yet to make his competitive debut.

players.name: Moisés Caicedo
players.style: The engine. Covers absurd ground, wins the ball back high up the pitch, and is the first name on any Alonso midfield when fit.

players.name: Enzo Fernández
players.previously: Benfica; River Plate; Defensa y Justicia (loan)
players.style: Deep-lying playmaker with the longest, most accurate passing range at the club. 2022 World Cup winner. Manchester City interest has made his position week-to-week.

players.name: Romeo Lavia
players.previously: Southampton; Manchester City academy; Anderlecht academy
players.style: Press-resistant holding midfielder who turns out of pressure and keeps the ball moving in tight areas. Availability has been the whole story of his Chelsea career.

players.name: Pedro Neto
players.style: Direct, one-v-one dribbler who attacks the byline and cuts back. Alonso has trusted him in less natural, deeper roles when rotating.

players.name: Cole Palmer
players.style: Left-footed, drifts inside from the right, arrives late into the box, ice-cold from the penalty spot. Left out of England's World Cup squad, which should sharpen him.

players.name: Morgan Rogers
players.atChelsea: July 2026, £117m ($157m) from Aston Villa — club record and the most expensive British player ever
players.previously: Aston Villa; Middlesbrough; Manchester City academy; loans at Lincoln, Bournemouth and West Brom
players.style: Powerful, low-slung ball carrier who takes possession on the half-turn and drives straight at defenders, and presses like a midfielder. Paired with Palmer as the two tens.

players.name: João Pedro
players.style: Mobile, link-heavy forward rather than a target man: drops between the lines, spins in behind, presses from the front. Omitted from Brazil's World Cup squad.

players.name: Estêvão
players.atChelsea: Since July 2025, £29m plus add-ons from Palmeiras
players.style: Explosive right-sided dribbler who shoots early and often from the left channel.

players.name: Liam Delap
players.previously: Ipswich Town; Manchester City academy; loans at Stoke and Preston
players.style: Physical, direct centre-forward who runs the channels and occupies centre-backs.

players.name: Jamie Gittens
players.atChelsea: Since July 2025, £48.5m plus add-ons from Borussia Dortmund
players.style: Left-footed touchline winger built on acceleration and one-v-one dribbling.

players.name: Valentin Barco
players.previously: Brighton; Sevilla and Strasbourg (loans); Boca Juniors
players.style: Left-footed wing-back with a fine delivery and a low centre of gravity.

players.name: Danny Welbeck
players.style: Experienced forward who presses intelligently and holds the ball up. Brighton's record Premier League scorer.

players.name: Geovany Quenda
players.atChelsea: July 2026, about £40m from Sporting CP — deal pre-agreed in 2025
players.style: Direct right-sided winger who can also play wing-back, quick in transition and comfortable taking defenders on one-v-one.
